title: Deli
question: How do you pick deli section foods?
decision: Ask about deli salads, prepared meals or lunch meat by name.
why: Meats, cheeses and salads in the deli all need refrigeration. Hot foods hold at 140°F or above.
short_answer: The deli case holds meats, cheeses and salads, and all of them need refrigeration. Hot foods are held at 140°F or above. For one food, ask about deli salads, prepared meals or lunch meat.
detail: Breads and dry snacks are fine out of the cold, but all meats, cheeses and salad products need refrigeration. Hot buffet items are held at a minimum of 140°F, and cold items below 40°F. Lunch meat and rotisserie chicken each have a card of their own.
kristy_take: The deli holds several questions in one case. Salads, hot food and lunch meat each read differently.
cart_pick: Deli foods from the cold case
buying_tips: Check that meats, cheeses and salads sit in a refrigerated case.
For hot food, look for a case held at 140°F or above.
Ask about one food by name: deli salads, prepared meals or lunch meat.
watch_out: Meats, cheeses or salads left out of a refrigerated case are a red flag.
tier_note: Meats, cheeses and salads in the deli belong in the cold.
asked_as: which deli section foods should i buy
are deli section foods worth buying
which store deli case foods should i buy
_do_line: Check the cold case first; meats, cheeses and salads all need it.
